positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Full stack software development on a C# based web application
- Designed and implemented a background service for offloading and scheduling tasks that are not time sensitive. Built to work with a containerized application for scalable solutions.
- Designed and implemented Azure Yaml Pipelines for automating performance metric collection and reporting.
- Designed and implemented a user service to authenticate with OAuth for data firewalling
- Designed and implemented user workflows for processing complex financial transactions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Agile-based front to back end software development for a back office accounting system
-Developed enterprise financial software built in C#
-Worked with Mass Transit, RabbitMQ, MongoDB, Node.js, Knockout.js, and IIS
-Interacted with multiple teams to gather requirements and produce solutions

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer
positions.description:
-Designed and managed a complete automated regression testing framework
-Web-based testing using C# and Selenium
-Front to back end + application integration testing of back office accounting software
-Trained and lead a junior automation engineer on the project

positions.title: Application Support Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
-Maintained and implemented SQL code, XPath, and XSLTs for existing clients
-Trained and interviewed new hires
-Interacted with clients to discuss and resolve issues
-Upgraded and deployed updates to client production environments

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-Collaborated with a small team to concept, develop, and maintain a website implemented in Wordpress
-Designed an embeddable subsidy calculator to be used for the government health care reform
-Aided development team in creating a system to pull medical data from government servers
-Regulated development through JIRA task flow and subversion control
-Reproduced production bugs, created fixes, and tested on release
